description: This file contains implementation of a keypoint detection system used for object tracking in images, including functions for scoring, sorting, selecting, and detecting keypoints using algorithms such as Harris and FAST, along with image processing utilities.

classes.name: KeypointDetector
classes.description: Main class implementing keypoint detection logic including scoring, sorting, selection, and FAST detector.

classes.name: InterestMap
classes.description: Utility class used for marking and validating keypoint locations during selection process.

classes.name: Keypoint
classes.description: Structure representing a keypoint, including position, score, and type.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: Structure containing image data needed for keypoint detection, including pyramid levels and gradient images.

methods.name: void ScoreKeypoints(const ImageData & image_data,const int num_candidates,Keypoint * const candidate_keypoints)
methods.description: Scores candidate keypoints based on Harris filter and skin detection if enabled.

methods.name: void SortKeypoints(const int num_candidates,Keypoint * const candidate_keypoints) const
methods.description: Sorts keypoints in descending order by their score using quicksort.

methods.name: int SelectKeypointsInBox(const BoundingBox & box,const Keypoint * const candidate_keypoints,const int num_candidates,const int max_keypoints,const int num_existing_keypoints,const Keypoint * const existing_keypoints,Keypoint * const final_keypoints) const
methods.description: Selects keypoints within a bounding box, ensuring spatial distribution and avoiding overlap.

methods.name: void SelectKeypoints(const std::vector<BoundingBox> & boxes,const Keypoint * const candidate_keypoints,const int num_candidates,FramePair * const curr_change) const
methods.description: Selects keypoints that fall inside the provided bounding boxes.

methods.name: int TestCircle(const int circle_perimeter,const int threshold,const uint8_t * const center_ptr,const int * offsets)
methods.description: Tests pixels along a circle perimeter for contrast above or below a threshold to identify blob-like features.

methods.name: float HarrisFilter(const Image<int32_t> & I_x,const Image<int32_t> & I_y,const float x,const float y) const
methods.description: Calculates a Harris score indicating likelihood of a corner at a given pixel.

methods.name: int AddExtraCandidatesForBoxes(const std::vector<BoundingBox> & boxes,const int max_num_keypoints,Keypoint * const keypoints) const
methods.description: Adds synthetic keypoints within bounding boxes for enhanced detection.

methods.name: void FindKeypoints(const ImageData & image_data,const std::vector<BoundingBox> & rois,const FramePair & prev_change,FramePair * const curr_change)
methods.description: Main function to locate keypoints in images, incorporating FAST detection, scoring, sorting, and selection.

methods.name: int CopyKeypoints(const FramePair & prev_change,Keypoint * const new_keypoints)
methods.description: Copies keypoints identified in the previous frame for tracking continuity.

methods.name: int FindFastKeypoints(const Image<uint8_t> & frame,const int quadrant,const int downsample_factor,const int max_num_keypoints,Keypoint * const keypoints)
methods.description: Detects keypoints using the FAST corner detector on image pyramid levels.
